status: source-design-only; no C mutation or native execution
source_facts: CleanupHandles holds THROW_ON_FAILURE around referenced native immediates, request cancellation, handle close, and actual uv_run cleanup.
Scope Open saves the old isolate boolean and stores false; Close restores it. Allow scope temporarily restores allowed=true and later restores prior state.
V8 throws the rooted ordinary primitive string 'illegal access'. It does not construct an Error or signal native termination/fatal.

Direct API function calls and API accessor callbacks are permitted by the source fast path. JavaScript functions, builtin function calls, callable proxies, bound functions and defined JS accessors reach guarded Execution::Invoke.
Proxy property operations retain ordinary native lookup. A missing trap can read data normally. A present callable trap uses Execution::Call and the same direct-API exception or JS guard.

Nonempty microtask checkpoint reaches guard before dequeue. Local TryCatch swallows the ordinary guard throw; the previous continuation frame is restored, queue remains, OnCompleted runs and processed count is zero in release. Empty checkpoint skips guard/frame exchange. True termination has a different queue-clearing path.

Current QuickJS has one JS_CallInternal dispatch, a distinct constructor dispatch before receiver allocation, native AF step, and JS_ExecutePendingJob before removal. Engine-level checks cannot protect these raw C operations.

proposed_c_scope.contract: Return prior flag. Use saved=false exchange and unconditional restoration; nested allow/disallow uses exact saved prior. No allocation, getter, pending consumption, or callback on either exchange.
proposed_c_scope.runtime_flag: Initialize allowed=true in JS_NewRuntime2; scope is runtime-wide across actual contexts.
proposed_c_scope.reason: Preallocate one owned primitive 'illegal access' string during runtime initialization, release at runtime teardown. Blocked call duplicates/throws that string without allocation. Existing current pending is returned unchanged, including actual uncatchable reasons.
proposed_c_scope.callable_metadata: Use an explicit host-only API-function provenance bit, default false for ordinary builtin/bytecode/ported Source callables. Do not infer the V8 API exemption from C implementation alone. Expose a checked setter only for genuine native callback classes, excluding bytecode, native AF, bound and proxy identities. Actual Node C++ binding factories may mark their direct callback during staging; Source NodeFunction/native AF algorithms remain guarded.
proposed_c_scope.dispatch: Guard JS_CallInternal after existing interrupt and intrinsic callable checks but before any class callback or bytecode activation; include GENERATOR resume path. Guard JS_CallConstructorInternal after constructor brand check but before class callback/newTarget prototype/receiver creation. Verify native AF continuation entry cannot bypass the guard; job gate blocks normal resumption before any dequeue.
proposed_c_scope.data_operations: Do not blanket-block Get/Set/ToPrimitive APIs. Their actual selected getter/setter/proxy callback enters the real guarded dispatcher; ordinary data and intrinsic native operations remain available.
proposed_c_scope.jobs: Under disallow and no prior actual pending, JS_ExecutePendingJob returns 0 before dequeue/hook/body/root retirement, preserving queue. Existing current pending under this gate returns -1 with its original reason. Empty queue remains 0/NULL. Update documented zero result to include no-progress under disallow. Root's checkpoint loop must stop on zero; OnCompleted remains the Node checkpoint owner's job.
proposed_c_scope.off_state: All ordinary paths remain unchanged when the flag is allowed; no universal new Engine-only gate, no replacement cancellation/termination policy.

scope_limits: Root approval of actual native API provenance API and graph adoption is required before C mutation.
No CRASH_ON_FAILURE or DUMP_ON_FAILURE mode is needed by CleanupHandles; only ordinary THROW mode and nested Allow restoration are proposed.
Native cleanup hooks still execute directly; only attempted JavaScript dispatch is blocked. Ordinary scope failure must not be promoted to native fatal.

JS_Eval compile-only remains permitted; actual evaluation is guarded at executable entry. C module host initialization and ordinary allocation are not mislabeled JavaScript merely because reached from a VM API.
Continuation-preserved embedder data is a separate next source unit. Existing execution_context, promise reaction capability capture and hook remain intact.
control_plan: Nested disallow/allow and restoration across ordinary/fatal pending, with no allocation or reason replacement.
Raw bytecode call and precompiled execution blocked with exact ordinary primitive, poisoned global Error ignored, actual limit1 proving no guard allocation.
Guarded actual native Source synchronous callback and native AF initial entry: no body/capability/prototype progress.
Direct explicitly marked native API callback/accessor allowed; attempted nested JavaScript call then blocks at the actual callee.
Defined getter and setter block before their first own-data progress statement while ordinary data access succeeds.

Proxy absent trap permits data access; selected native/JS trap and handler getter follow actual dispatch; direct callable proxy and bound API function remain blocked before handler/bound target progress.
Constructor guard precedes newTarget prototype getter for JS/Source constructors; marked actual native API constructor follows its true native path.
Runtime-wide cross-context scope; selected callback ownership remains borrowed and values retire once.
Nonempty queued real Promise job survives disallow plus GC with zero hook/body visits, zero processed result and no manufactured pending; after restore the exact job resumes.
Empty job checkpoint remains zero; caller can stop without spinning on retained queue.
Actual prior ordinary and uncatchable pending reasons survive blocked call/job exactly; no extra guest catch/finally progresses.
Current native fatal created by an allowed native API callback wins over any later attempted blocked JavaScript entry.
Scope and API marker changes do not affect normal no-scope behavior or global function shapes/descriptors.

#define PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_SCOPE_DEFINITION(ScopeType, field, enable)      \
  ScopeType::ScopeType(Isolate* isolate)                                   \
      : isolate_(isolate), old_data_(isolate->field()) {                   \
    DCHECK_NOT_NULL(isolate);                                              \
    isolate_->set_##field(enable);                                         \
  }                                                                        \
                                                                           \
  ScopeType::~ScopeType() { isolate_->set_##field(old_data_); }            \
                                                                           \
  /* static */                                                             \
  bool ScopeType::IsAllowed(Isolate* isolate) { return isolate->field(); } \
                                                                           \
  /* static */                                                             \
  void ScopeType::Open(Isolate* isolate, bool* was_execution_allowed) {    \
    DCHECK_NOT_NULL(isolate);                                              \
    DCHECK_NOT_NULL(was_execution_allowed);                                \
    *was_execution_allowed = isolate->field();                             \
    isolate->set_##field(enable);                                          \
  }                                                                        \
  /* static */                                                             \
  void ScopeType::Close(Isolate* isolate, bool was_execution_allowed) {    \
    DCHECK_NOT_NULL(isolate);                                              \
    isolate->set_##field(was_execution_allowed);                           \
  }

#define PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_ENABLE_SCOPE_DEFINITION(EnableType, _, field, \
                                                   enable)               \
  PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_SCOPE_DEFINITION(EnableType, field, enable)

#define PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_DISABLE_SCOPE_DEFINITION(_, DisableType, field, \
                                                    enable)                \
  PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_SCOPE_DEFINITION(DisableType, field, enable)

PER_ISOLATE_DCHECK_TYPE(PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_ENABLE_SCOPE_DEFINITION, true)
PER_ISOLATE_CHECK_TYPE(PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_ENABLE_SCOPE_DEFINITION, true)
PER_ISOLATE_DCHECK_TYPE(PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_DISABLE_SCOPE_DEFINITION, false)
PER_ISOLATE_CHECK_TYPE(PER_ISOLATE_ASSERT_DISABLE_SCOPE_DEFINITION, false)
